name.title: DP_EFS_VOLUME_STATS
name.sysdesc: Contains block by block information about the engineering file system volumes.

field.sysdesc: Volume id for this volume stat: ENG0: 0 ENG1: 1 DP: 2
Total number of blocks in the volume
Number of free blocks on this volume
Number of bad blocks on this volume
Total number of writable pages on volume.
Total number of boxes allocated to this volume.
Total number of boxes in use by the volume.
Minimum wear count among all in use blocks
Maximum wear count among all use blocks
Minimum version among all blocks in the volume
Maximum version among block in volume.
Total number of block erases on partition since last mount
Total number of writes on partition since last mount
Total number of pages copies since last mount
Total number of full page reads since last mount
Total number of page header reads since last mount
Total number of error events which were corrected/fixed by the EMEM DMR logic
Total number emem nand dma events which returned corrupt data
Total number of emem nand dma hardware failures since last mount
The starting block for this volume.
Total number of files on this volume.
Total number of directories on this volume.

dynamic_array.sysdesc: Array of block statistic information. Each entry represents a single block

field.sysdesc: The logical block number (stripe) for this block.
Byte representing the bad block status of the block.
Number of dirty pages on this block. These are pages that have been written.
Number of live pages on this block. These are dirty pages which contain valid/live data.
Total number of error events which were corrected/fixed by the EMEM DMR logic
Total number emem nand dma events which returned corrupt data
Total number of emem nand dma hardware failures since last mount
The version number for this block.
Total wear count for this logical block. This is represents the maximum wears amount any block that composes this logical block (stripe).
